summary: Before a bill comes up, its sponsor and advisers spend a weekend trying out questions colleagues might ask.
realLife: Vogelsinger took notes at Kennedy’s home as he rehearsed labor-bill questions with advisers.
inGame: floor-debate supplies the bill and speakers. needs: a rehearsal with questions linked to draft answers.

turns.what: The sponsor stops at a question nobody at the table can answer.
turns.pulledBy: The amendment's effect depends on an agency interpretation.
turns.writesBack: The briefing sheet marks an open question for counsel.

turns.what: The advisers repeat part of the rehearsal the next morning.
turns.pulledBy: The bill text changes after the evening discussion.
turns.writesBack: The morning notes replace the answer on that clause.
